searchText: Interop note: Erigon falls over with current Lighthouse. "Falls over" as in stops responding on Engine API / eth_syncing and can't shut down fully on SIGTERM. Reproducible on Goerli and mainnet. <https://github.com/ledgerwatch/erigon/issues/7172>
